source_review.notes: Checked all 12 structured references against current first-party Databricks, AWS, Microsoft, OpenLineage, Debezium, and Apache Iceberg documentation. Verified the scoped layer terminology, access-control mechanics, lineage entities, CDC envelope evidence, and snapshot promotion claims; every final URL returned HTTP 200 on the retrieval date.

evidence: Checked definitions for I, R, J, Q_0, S, D, Q_1, C, T_v, F, snapshot identifiers, exceptions, and lineage.
Checked displayed set, count, aggregation, storage, and mapping notation for defined symbols and balanced syntax.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation consistently separates intake, raw, standardized dispositions, curated snapshots, transformations, and lineage.

evidence: Executed zone-disposition-lineage and matched two accepted, one exact duplicate, one invalid, one conflict, both aggregates, lineage, and five-record reconciliation.
numerical_recomputation.notes: All concrete counts, monetary minor units, and executable outputs were independently recomputed.

evidence: Verified intake and standardization equations from mutually exclusive primary disposition partitions.
Expanded curated aggregation indicator sums and confirmed their dependence on declared grain, group, measure, unit, and correction semantics.
Verified total layer storage as the sum of raw, standardized, curated, quarantine, history, and replica components.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The equations are accounting and reproducibility models, not claims that rules or source completeness are correct.

evidence: Reviewed empty and incomplete cuts, schema drift, unknown/null/redacted values, time-zone folds, invalid amounts, exact duplicates, identity conflicts, and late corrections.
Reviewed quarantine outage, partial publication, stale catalog, direct-storage bypass, legal hold/erasure, backfill/live collision, reference lag, and no-consumer products.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Boundary analysis distinguishes raw fidelity from truth and zero accounting residue from source completeness or semantic accuracy.

evidence: Traced immutable raw evidence, deterministic standardization, owned quarantine, curated product contracts, lineage, and atomic publication through examples and answers.
Confirmed every raw observation in the executable receives exactly one primary disposition and accepted curated values trace to occurrence IDs.
invariant_checking.notes: Security, retention, erasure, and correction obligations propagate across layers rather than being inferred from zone labels.

evidence: Reviewed the seven-step no-silent-standardization-loss proof from fixed raw snapshot and rule version through one disposition and atomic published reconciliation.
Checked that the conclusion requires identity completeness and prevents promotion on missing or multiply classified input.
proof_review.notes: The accounting proof is valid under its explicit classification, deterministic evaluation, and atomic-publication assumptions.

evidence: The no-silent-loss argument is explicitly labeled a proof sketch.
The following paragraph disclaims source completeness, rule correctness, repair completion, and universal consumer fitness.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No architecture convention or accounting identity is mislabeled as universal proof of data quality.

evidence: Provider layer and access-control descriptions are attributed to dated first-party documentation and presented as scoped examples rather than mandates.
The executable explicitly disclaims proof of source completeness, currency semantics, storage atomicity, access control, and business fitness.
Materialization and quality guidance requires measured evidence and named contracts.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Current product facts, local architecture choices, symbolic accounting, and executable observations remain distinct.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed the chapter end to end. It defines zones by contracts, preserves raw evidence without sanctifying it, makes standardization deterministic and reconciled, and treats curated outputs as purpose-specific products connected by snapshot lineage.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed source cuts, admission, identity, quarantine, publication, backfill/restatement, access, retention, erasure, observability, cost, and fault tests for implementability. Dangerous direct access and silent-drop paths receive explicit controls and finite reconciliation.

pedagogical_review.notes: Reviewed progression from recall through contracts, mechanisms, formal accounting, proof sketch, executable model, trade-offs, failures, ten examples, cross-program connections, and five distinct exercises with worked answers. Connections accurately bridge DE-061 to DE-063 and later quality modules.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
